G13.rule: counted when green > 0.5; soft when red byte < 127.5 x detail.minTexelsPerPixel; pass when soft/counted <= detail.maxSoftPixelFraction

definition.name: dog-band-energy-v1
definition.luma: sRGB luma 0.2126 R + 0.7152 G + 0.0722 B on 0..1 values, no linearisation
definition.band: difference of Gaussians: blur sigma 0.6 px minus blur sigma 2.0 px, which keeps roughly 0.08 to 0.3 cycles per pixel
definition.energy: mean of the squared band signal inside a tile
definition.tileEnergyFloor: max(2e-5, 0.05 x the 90th percentile of approved tile energy)
definition.ratio: per tile film energy / approved energy; median and 25th percentile over kept tiles
definition.resize: approved image centre cropped to the film aspect, then Lanczos to the film size
